Select approved drugs with a COVID-19 indication. Filter molecule_dictionary where max_phase = 4. Join drug_indication on molregno and filter indication_label or efo_term containing 'COVID-19'. Join compound_structures via INNER JOIN on molregno for canonical_smiles. Return columns: chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (aliased from drug_indication.efo_id), indication_label (aliased from drug_indication.efo_term or mesh_heading), max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
